content: Zoho Invoice (free, cloud): customizable invoice templates + template gallery with item-table look/feel customization, 10+ languages, schedule invoices, recurring invoices, quotes with expiration dates/custom fields/history/conversion to invoices, contacts management with customer portal, address format config for billing/shipping on PDF, items with SKUs/active-inactive, multi-level taxes, ~30 reports + dashboard, payment gateways (10+), credit notes/refunds, offline payments, custom payment receipts, expense tracking, project+timesheet billing. Strongly accounting-adjacent: expenses, projects, roles/permissions, inventory SKUs.
